tool_analysis:
Step Analysis:
- The recorded browser session navigated to the Magento admin Transactions grid, closed an incoming-message popup, entered Order ID and Transaction ID in the filter row, selected Transaction Type 'Authorization' and Is Closed 'No', then clicked Search. Recorded elementHash values are available for the popup close, both text inputs, both selects, and the Search button.

Task Definition:
- Build a reusable tool that navigates to the Magento admin Transactions page and applies grid filters: order_id, transaction_id, txn_type, is_closed, optional created_from/created_to. The tool must use deterministic selectors recorded (elementHash) to avoid flaky selector resolution.

Action Plan (detailed):
1) Navigate to the provided admin_transactions_url.
2) Click the incoming message popup close control (elementHash df76c6ce85) so the filter row is visible.
3) Input Order ID into the recorded Order ID input (elementHash 2e1ab70e63). Empty string allowed.
4) Input Transaction ID into the recorded Transaction ID input (elementHash aa9671f0a9). Empty string allowed.
5) Set Transaction Type via the recorded select (elementHash eaf63619c9) choosing by visible label.
6) Set Is Closed via the recorded select (elementHash de66e8a7e6) choosing by visible label.
7) Optionally enter created_from and created_to (if provided) using the recorded input elements.
8) Click the Search button (elementHash 1171e5500a) to apply filters.

Variable Identification (inputs required):
- admin_transactions_url (required): the full URL to open.
- order_id (optional): order increment id string to enter.
- transaction_id (optional): gateway transaction id string to enter.
- txn_type (optional): visible label matching select options (All/Order/Authorization/Capture/Void/Refund).
- is_closed (optional): visible label (All/Yes/No).
- created_from / created_to (optional): date strings in MM/DD/YYYY.

Step Optimization:
- Deterministic interactions: elementHash values captured in the session are used to ensure each click/input targets exactly the recorded element.
- Navigation optimised: single navigation step opens the transactions page directly (no intermediate clicks required).
- Combined/omitted steps: only essential steps are present. Date fields are optional and use the same recorded inputs; if the page has different date input elementHashes those fields will remain empty (the tool will input empty strings if parameters are not provided).
- No conditional branching: each step is executed in order. Empty input parameters result in entering empty strings or leaving selects at default.

Notes and caveats:
- The tool assumes the session has an authenticated admin user (the recorded session performed login earlier). Do not include authentication steps in the tool.
- The incoming-message popup close step is deterministic (elementHash df76c6ce85). If the popup does not exist in another environment this click may fail — it was recorded present in this session. If execution environments vary, replace the close click with an agentic check step in future iterations.
- Select options were recorded by visible labels; if the target environment uses different option values, the visible label should still select the matching option. For programmatic precision the select option values can be read at runtime and mapped when necessary.
name: magento_admin_transactions_search_tool
description: Search Magento Admin > Sales > Transactions grid by filling filter inputs (Order ID, Transaction ID), selecting Transaction Type and Is Closed, and clicking Search. Uses recorded stable element hashes from the session for deterministic interactions. Navigates to the Transactions page, closes the incoming-message popup (if present), fills filters, and applies Search.

steps.description: Open the Magento Admin Transactions page (starting point for filters).
Close the incoming-message popup (top-right 'close' in the notice). This elementHash was recorded on the page and ensures the filter row is unobstructed.
Enter the Order ID into the Order ID filter input (filter row, column 2). If {order_id} is empty the step inputs an empty string.
Enter the Transaction ID into the Transaction ID filter input (filter row, column 3). If {transaction_id} is empty the step inputs an empty string.

Select Transaction Type in the Transaction Type dropdown (filter row, column 6). Use one of: All, Order, Authorization, Capture, Void, Refund. If {txn_type} is empty the site default/select remains unchanged.
Select Is Closed in the Is Closed dropdown (filter row, column 7). Use one of: All, Yes, No. If {is_closed} is empty the site default/select remains unchanged.
Optional: enter Created At 'From' date if provided. (Re-uses the recorded input element pattern for the left-side date input if present.)
Optional: enter Created At 'To' date if provided. (Re-uses the recorded input element pattern for right-side date input if present.)
Click the Search button to apply the grid filters (recorded Search button elementHash).

input_schema.name: admin_transactions_url
input_schema.description: Full URL to the Magento admin Transactions page (example: "http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin/sales_transactions/").

input_schema.name: order_id
input_schema.description: Order increment id to filter by. Leave empty to skip (an empty string will be entered).

input_schema.name: transaction_id
input_schema.description: Gateway transaction id to filter by (txn_id). Leave empty to skip.

input_schema.name: txn_type
input_schema.description: Transaction Type visible label to select in the Transaction Type filter. Use one of the listed labels. If omitted, use 'All'.

input_schema.name: is_closed
input_schema.description: Is Closed visible label to select in the Is Closed filter. Use 'Yes' or 'No' (or 'All'). If omitted, use 'All'.

input_schema.name: created_from
input_schema.description: Optional Created At 'From' date in MM/DD/YYYY format. Leave empty if not used.

input_schema.name: created_to
input_schema.description: Optional Created At 'To' date in MM/DD/YYYY format. Leave empty if not used.
